prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic 9:16 direct-flash editorial portrait of one original approved adult woman seated low on concrete stairs in gray plaid tailoring.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with voluminous golden-blonde hair and bottleneck bangs, blue-green eyes, natural pores and skin texture, neutral intense gaze, glossy black nail lacquer, white cotton poplin shirt, tailored gray Prince of Wales check blazer and matching lower garment, deep-crimson satin necktie, and barefoot styling.
composition_elements: Subject sits in a low crouched position on concrete stairs with knees raised, hands near the feet, and face and extremities visible in a tight 9:16 vertical frame.
White plaster stairwell with subtle stippled texture, terracotta-toned step nosing, and a black tubular handrail in the background.
Hard flash shadow falls against the wall; maintain the gray plaid geometry, crimson tie, black nails, bare feet, and raw candid framing.
Keep the direct gaze and natural hand and toe anatomy consistent.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct high-intensity on-camera flash with sharp drop shadow, high-contrast chiaroscuro, specular highlights on skin and black lacquer, and realistic flash falloff.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 9:16 vertical medium close-up, 50mm or 85mm prime lens at f/2.8, ISO 200, 8K detail, sharp face and hands/feet, realistic cotton, wool-blend, skin, concrete, and nail texture, subtle film grain, no text or watermark.
